why: The add-on shipped only an armv7l build, so CoreELEC 22 (aarch64 user space) reported a missing runtime when the Tencent Aurora remote was selected.
The 32-bit object cannot be used there: no ELF32 loading into an ELF64 process, no 32-bit loader and no 32-bit libc in the aarch64 user space.
The vendored decoder is self-contained and only needs libavutil's public transform API, so the same source is rebuilt for aarch64.
link_inputs: dl/box-ffmpeg/libavutil.so.61 (copied off the target box; supplies DT_NEEDED only)
public_system_api: FFmpeg libavutil 61: av_tx_init, av_tx_uninit, av_mallocz, av_free, avutil_version
verification: Loaded through ctypes on the box: create() succeeded, a real 60-byte frame returned 640 bytes of S16_LE with 320/320 non-zero samples. Symbol set matches the armv7l build.
